meta.title: Request for Re-Evaluation is enabled only in Evaluation Time
gaps: Reliably selecting a specific technical event that is outside Evaluation Time when no event title, ID, or prepared state is provided
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Reliably selecting a specific technical event that is outside Evaluation Time when no event title, ID, or prepared state is provided

steps.note: Open an existing event expected to be outside Evaluation Time.
Assert that the Technical Stage Settings menu disables Request for Re-Evaluation outside Evaluation Time.
Open an existing event with a closed technical response waiting for evaluation, which places the event in the evaluation flow.
Assert that Request for Re-Evaluation is enabled in the Technical Stage Settings menu during Evaluation Time.
